description: Co-located evaluation benchmark for agent-debug hypothesis-driven RCA skill

test_cases.description: Ensures agent-debug creates hypothesis boards, minimal repros, and relies strictly on empirical log evidence.

test_cases.description: When RCA is wrong tool/prompt/schema in the current session, agent-debug must promote a prod-derived EDD case and run wk eval - not only a code regression or prose lesson.
test_cases.prompt: In this chat the agent called search_kit when the user asked for the architecture of payment-api. Debug the routing miss and make sure it cannot regress.
